source: https://imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main?registerMain (field attributes, key filters and submit checks, read 2026-10-15)

full_name.label: Name (full name)
full_name.help: One box for your full name, as printed on the passport photo page and in the same order. The MDAC takes letters and spaces only: type a space for a hyphen and leave apostrophes out.

errors.invalidChars: Use the Latin spelling from your passport, letters and spaces only

passport.label: Passport No.
passport.help: Printed on the photo page of your passport. Up to 12 letters and digits, no spaces.

errors.tooShort: Check the number on your passport photo page
errors.tooLong: Passport number too long — max 12 characters
errors.invalidChars: Letters and numbers only — no spaces or symbols
errors.invalidFormat: Letters and numbers only, up to 12 — no spaces or dashes

nationality.label: Nationality / Citizenship
nationality.help: The country that issued your passport. On the MDAC you pick it from a list such as CHN - CHINA.

date_of_birth.label: Date of Birth
date_of_birth.help: DD/MM/YYYY, as the MDAC calendar fills it in. The calendar stops at yesterday.

errors.tooEarly: Date of birth seems too far in the past — double check
errors.tooLate: Date of birth must be before today

passport_expiry.label: Date of Passport Expiry
passport_expiry.help: DD/MM/YYYY. The MDAC calendar starts from today. Malaysia also requires six months or more of validity from your date of entry, which the calendar does not check.

errors.tooEarly: This date has passed — the passport has expired

email.label: Email Address
email.help: Typed twice on the MDAC. Up to 100 characters; before the @ the form takes letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores only, so no +.

errors.invalidFormat: Not accepted by the MDAC: before the @ use letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores (no +)

mobile.label: Mobile No.
mobile.help: Digits only, up to 12. The country code goes in the separate Country / Region Code list.

errors.required: Mobile number is required on the MDAC
errors.invalidFormat: Digits only, up to 12 — no +, spaces or dashes. Pick the country code from the separate list.

arrival_date.label: Date of Arrival
arrival_date.help: DD/MM/YYYY. The MDAC calendar offers only today and the next two days.

errors.tooEarly: Arrival date cannot be in the past
errors.tooLate: The MDAC only takes an arrival date from today to two days ahead. Come back closer to the date.

departure_date.label: Date of Departure
departure_date.help: Required on the MDAC. DD/MM/YYYY; the calendar there starts from your arrival date.

errors.tooEarly: Departure date cannot be in the past

flight_number.label: Flight / Vessel / Transportation No.
flight_number.help: Required for air, land and sea, up to 30 characters: letters, digits, spaces and @ / - ( ) , ' only. By sea or road, the vessel, bus or vehicle number.

errors.required: Flight, vessel or transport number is required

last_port.label: Last Port of Embarkation before Malaysia
last_port.help: A country list, not an airport code: the country where you boarded the flight, ship or vehicle into Malaysia.

errors.required: Choose the country where you boarded

accommodation.label: Address (In Malaysia)
accommodation.help: First address line, up to 100 characters: at least three words, letters, digits, spaces and @ / - ( ) , ' only. On the MDAC a second line, State, City and a 5-digit Postcode follow.

errors.invalidFormat: At least three words, using letters, digits, spaces and @ / - ( ) , ' only
